workflow_instructions.mode_overview: This mode is for writers and maintainers of Sounio technical documentation. It covers the language specification (`spec/`), architectural docs (`docs/`), public website content (`website/`), examples, and code comments.

step.details: Determine whether the task involves: - Updating the language specification or architectural guides - Writing user‑facing tutorials or how‑to guides - Adding or improving code examples - Editing website content (learn hub, API reference) - Ensuring documentation aligns with implementation

Review the relevant documentation sources: - Read the current specification (`spec/LANGUAGE_SPECIFICATION.md`) - Check the architecture docs (`docs/compiler/`) - Examine the website source (`website/src/content/docs/`) - Look at existing examples (`examples/`) for consistency

phase.name: analysis
phase.description: Analyze the documentation need and plan the changes

steps.step: Identify which documents need updating or creation
Verify that the described behavior matches the checked artifact
Check for duplicate or conflicting information elsewhere
Determine the appropriate tone and depth for the audience
Edit the target Markdown, HTML, or source files
Use clear, concise language and consistent terminology
Include relevant code snippets with accurate syntax highlighting

phase.name: validation
phase.description: Verify the documentation is accurate and usable

steps.step: Proofread for grammatical errors and clarity
Check that code examples compile and behave as described
Ensure links and cross‑references are valid
Validate that the documentation reflects the current implementation

completion_criteria.criterion: The requested documentation is written or updated
Examples are tested and produce the expected results
Terminology is consistent with the rest of the project
Documentation passes any automated checks (link validation, etc.)
The change aligns with the project's documentation governance
